summary: Confirmed all six estimates against the supplied PDF after reading the complete markdown, including references and Appendix A. All 34 non-null numeric statistical fields and the randomized counts match the printed values and belong to the recorded outcomes and arms. Outcome coding, analysis units, AI availability and timing, comparison types, and uncertainty bases agree with the codebook. Analysis-specific participant counts are not printed and appropriately remain null. The appendix robustness comparison contains no transcribable numerical arm summaries or exact test results; its graphical significance annotation is documented without conversion. No eligible outcome or full-sample contrast is missing. The internally inconsistent TF-IDF t statistic and quantity SEM p-value/confidence interval are faithfully transcribed and already flagged in the extraction; they are paper reporting issues, not extraction errors.
